dedupe_keys.name: germanrenewableenergy hourly wind and solar model

description: GermanRenewableEnergy is a software model for estimating hourly output from Germany's registered solar panels and wind turbines. It combines installation information from the German MaStR register with ERA5 weather fields and calculates generation capacity factors for specified years from 2000 through 2023. Users provide asset data, weather and run settings; outputs are hourly and aggregated renewable-generation series by plant or geographic unit. Geographic coverage is Germany, with time constrained by the available source years. AGPL-3.0 source, installation and execution guides are public. A limitation is that a calculated capacity factor is not metered generation and inherits errors in installation dates, location and weather. It can build historical wind and solar inputs for German electricity-network scenarios. The related catalogue ERA5 record is a weather input, not this calculated output. No MaStR register dump, ERA5 fields or package was downloaded.
inputs: MaStR solar and wind assets with ERA5 weather
